summary: Led non-partisan civic engagement and youth empowerment initiatives, organizing voter education workshops and leveraging digital communication channels to mobilize active youth participation.
Facilitated community dialogue, youth leadership seminars, and digital inclusion projects that foster cross-cultural collaboration and sustainable community development.

Assisted in coordinating state-level initiatives aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, with particular focus on Quality Education (SDG 4), Decent Work and Economic Growth (SDG 8), and Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure (SDG 9).
